videoTitle: VTH1 Rooftop Parking AC Installation Guide

exteriorDimensions.orientation: The 925 mm length runs front-to-back on the vehicle roof, perpendicular to the front and rear roof edges. The 891 mm dimension runs left-to-right across the vehicle roof.
exteriorDimensions.fanPosition: rear section of the rooftop unit

coreMessage: Fits clear roof openings from 20.1 in x 15.0 in to 31.5 in x 19.3 in.
dimensionOrientationNote: Confirmed from product drawing: product length runs front-to-back on the vehicle roof. The fan grille is placed toward the rear of the vehicle.

fitStates.rule: Measured clear opening is smaller than 20.1 in x 15.0 in / 510 x 380 mm
Measured clear opening is within 20.1 in x 15.0 in to 31.5 in x 19.3 in
Measured clear opening is larger than 31.5 in x 19.3 in / 800 x 490 mm

installationSteps: Compare opening with VTH1 fit range
Apply sealing foam around the roof opening
Install inner mounting frame and tighten bolts evenly
Test cooling and check for airflow and sealing
electricalLabel: 12V / 24V system versions: follow product label and manual
safetyLabels: Use fuse protection near the battery
Professional installation recommended for cutting and electrical work

referenceStyle.opening: Start with the finished installed look, then explain the installation.
referenceStyle.pace: Short, clean, product-forward, clear enough for first-time installers.
referenceStyle.differentiator: Show the clear roof opening fit range more explicitly than competitor videos.
